rawContent: #harveyweinstein is being remanded and sent directly to jail. His attorneys asked the judge to let him go home until his sentencing.  For context, #billcosby was allowed to go home on house arrest until his sentencing.  #tedwinn #MeToo
When police traumatize innocent citizens, there should be penalties!  It’s NOT ok to detain, handcuff and forcibly remove somebody who has not committed a crime! #tedwinn #nypd #BlackLivesMatter
